Coram: The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J.M.Khazi
 Oral Order

(Per: The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J.M.Khazi) Petitioners, respondent No.2 and their respective
counsel are present.

Learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1-State is also
present.

2. This petition is filed by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 under Section 482 of the Criminal
Procedure Code for short, 'the Cr.P.C.') to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against them in
C.C.No.163/2020 pending on the file of the Ii Additional Civil Judge and Jmfc, Gadag for the
offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian
Penal Code (for short, 'the Ipc').

It is submitted by learned counsel representing both parties that in Cril.Misc.No.193/2018 on the file of the JMFC-II Court, Gadag, filed by respondent No.2 for recovery of maintenance, a settlement is arrived at between the parties.

The respondent No.2 has received a sum of Rs.7,50,000/- through D.D. Rs.5,28,234/- towards permanent alimony and the marriage between petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 is dissolved by way of Khula Nama and that respondent No.2 has undertaken to withdraw C.C.No.163/2020 which is sought to be quashed in the present petition.

Respondent No.2 submitted that she has no objection to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioner in C.C.No.163/2020 and there are no other criminal cases and other cases pending between the parties.

4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, this court is of the considered opinion that continuation of the criminal proceedings would NC: 2024:KHC-D:16206 amount to abuse of Rasheed Alias Mohammadrasheed S/O. ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194722107/
2 process of court and therefore, it is liable to be quashed and accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) The criminal petition is allowed.

ii) The complaint, FIR, charge sheet and entire criminal proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.163/2020 (crime No.159/2019 of Gadag Rural Police Station)
pending on the file of the II Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Gadag for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code are hereby quashed.
